title: Grade 1 ELA — Reading Short Stories and Finding Details
subject: English Language Arts
description: Practice with questions on who, what, where, when, sequence.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Ada puts a red cup by the sink. Her dad puts a blue cup beside it. Who puts down a red cup?
Ada puts a red cup by the sink. Her dad puts a blue cup beside it. Where is the blue cup?
Jo sees a wet kitten on the porch. Jo brings it a towel. What animal does Jo see?
Jo sees a wet kitten on the porch. Jo brings it a towel. Why might Jo bring a towel?
Min helps Dad bake. They mix flour first. They put the pan in the oven last. What do they do first?
choices: put the pan in the oven

questions.question: Min helps Dad bake. They mix flour first. They put the pan in the oven last. What goes into the oven?
The bus stopped at the park. Children got off and walked to the swings. Where did the bus stop?
The bus stopped at the park. Children got off and walked to the swings. Where did the children go after getting off?
Rae hangs a bell by the back door. The wind blows and the bell rings. What makes the bell ring?
Rae hangs a bell by the back door. The wind blows and the bell rings. Where is the bell?
Ben planted a seed. A week later, a leaf peeked out of the soil. What did Ben plant?
Ben planted a seed. A week later, a leaf peeked out of the soil. What did Ben see later?
Luz and Ana built a tower. A wheel rolled into it. The tower fell. What did the children build?
Luz and Ana built a tower. A wheel rolled into it. The tower fell. What made it fall?
Eli packed an apple and a book. At the park, he ate the apple before he read. What did Eli pack to read?
Eli packed an apple and a book. At the park, he ate the apple before he read. Which happened first at the park?
choices: He packed a bag at the park.

questions.question: Sam went to the pond. Sam saw three ducks. Then one duck flew away. What did Sam see at the pond?
Sam went to the pond. Sam saw three ducks. Then one duck flew away. What did one duck do next?
Meg lost a glove. She looked under the bed. She found it in her coat. What had Meg lost?
Meg lost a glove. She looked under the bed. She found it in her coat. Where did she find it?
